admission.justification: Spans deferral_gate_findings in knowledge_gate/deferrals.py and judge in knowledge_gate/gate.py, and is guarded by four gate tests.

applicability: Leaf closeout judgment over converted memory candidates and their B..C code diffs.
conditions: Blocking findings fire only when condition.task equals the leaf, condition.file's blob moved and lies in the leaf's own B..C diff, or the leaf confirmed a deferred dependent without editing its document.
Deferrals created by the current leaf (createdByLeaf == owner) never fire as due in that leaf.
Orphaned deferrals (terminal condition.task) and pre-base file changes outside the leaf's own B..C diff emit non-blocking warnings only.
Deferral checks stay in knowledge_gate rather than knowledge_validator so worktree_sync is never blocked.
exclusions: Master-end landing staleness checks, which remain governed by landing.py.
Staleness calculation of stands_on links, which is unchanged.
statement: The closeout gate blocks a leaf only for deferrals naming that leaf, deferrals whose watched file that leaf's own B..C diff changes, or an unedited confirmation of a deferred document, never in the creating leaf, never on worktree_sync, and treats orphaned deferrals and pre-base file changes on unrelated leaves as non-blocking warnings.
title: Closeout gate blocks only due or invalid deferrals and never worktree_sync
